title: The Library Mystery
summary: Two friends follow clues to return a lost bookmark.

sentences.text: Eva finds a silver bookmark under a table in the school library.
sentences.chineseHint: 伊娃在学校图书馆的桌下发现一枚银色书签。

sentences.text: A tiny drawing of an owl and the number twelve are carved into it.
sentences.chineseHint: 上面刻着一只小猫头鹰和数字十二。

sentences.text: Her friend Max thinks the number points to shelf twelve.
sentences.chineseHint: 她的朋友马克斯认为数字指向十二号书架。

sentences.text: On shelf twelve, they find a book about birds with a note inside.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们在十二号书架找到一本鸟类书，里面有一张纸条。

sentences.text: The note says, Please return my bookmark to Mrs. Green at the front desk.
sentences.chineseHint: 纸条写着：请把我的书签交给前台的格林老师。

sentences.text: Mrs. Green thanks them and explains that the bookmark belonged to her first student.
sentences.chineseHint: 格林老师感谢他们，并解释书签属于她的第一位学生。

sentences.text: Eva and Max solve the mystery by reading every clue carefully.
sentences.chineseHint: 伊娃和马克斯通过仔细阅读每条线索解开了谜团。

vocabulary.definition: a marker that keeps a place in a book

vocabulary.example: An owl is carved into it.

vocabulary.definition: a flat place where books are stored
vocabulary.example: The book is on a shelf.

vocabulary.definition: information that helps solve a mystery

questions.prompt: Where does Eva find the bookmark?
What does number twelve point to?

title: Nora Builds a Boat
summary: Nora improves a model boat by testing one change at a time.

sentences.text: Nora wants to build a small boat for the park pond.
sentences.chineseHint: 诺拉想为公园池塘造一艘小船。

sentences.text: She uses a flat piece of wood, a paper sail, and a straight stick.
sentences.chineseHint: 她用了平木片、纸帆和一根直木棍。

sentences.text: Her first boat tips over because the tall sail catches too much wind.
sentences.chineseHint: 第一艘船翻了，因为高帆接住了太多风。

sentences.text: Nora makes the sail smaller and adds clay under the center of the boat.
sentences.chineseHint: 诺拉把帆做小，并在船中央下方加了黏土。

sentences.text: The clay keeps the boat balanced while the sail moves it forward.
sentences.chineseHint: 黏土让船保持平衡，船帆推动它前进。

sentences.text: On the third test, the boat crosses the pond without tipping.
sentences.chineseHint: 第三次测试时，小船没有翻，顺利穿过池塘。

sentences.text: Nora writes each change in her notebook so she can remember what worked.
sentences.chineseHint: 诺拉把每次改动写进笔记本，记住什么方法有效。

vocabulary.definition: a small body of still water
cloth or paper that catches wind to move a boat
falls or leans to one side

questions.prompt: Where will Nora use the boat?
Why does the first boat tip?

title: The Day the Bees Rested
summary: A class discovers why a garden needs bees and flowers.

sentences.text: The school garden is usually busy with bees, but one Tuesday it is quiet.
sentences.chineseHint: 学校花园平时蜜蜂很多，但一个星期二却很安静。

sentences.text: The class notices that gardeners removed many wild flowers near the fence.
sentences.chineseHint: 同学们发现园丁移除了篱笆旁的许多野花。

sentences.text: Without enough flowers, the bees cannot find much nectar.
sentences.chineseHint: 没有足够的花，蜜蜂找不到多少花蜜。

sentences.text: The students plant lavender, sunflowers, and small blue herbs.
sentences.chineseHint: 学生们种下薰衣草、向日葵和蓝色小香草。

sentences.text: They leave a shallow dish of water with stones where bees can land safely.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们放了一只带石头的浅水盘，让蜜蜂安全落脚。

sentences.text: Two weeks later, bees return and carry pollen from flower to flower.
sentences.chineseHint: 两周后，蜜蜂回来，把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵。

sentences.text: The class learns that a healthy garden needs food, water, and safe places for insects.
sentences.chineseHint: 同学们明白健康花园需要昆虫的食物、水和安全空间。

vocabulary.example: Wild flowers grew near the fence.

questions.prompt: What do students put in the water dish?

title: Leo's First Market
summary: Leo compares prices and chooses food within a budget.

sentences.text: Leo takes ten dollars to the Saturday market for his family.
sentences.chineseHint: 利奥带着十美元去周六市场为家人买东西。

sentences.text: His list has bread, tomatoes, and four oranges.
sentences.chineseHint: 清单上有面包、西红柿和四个橙子。

sentences.text: One stall sells oranges for one dollar each, but another sells four for three dollars.
sentences.chineseHint: 一个摊位橙子一美元一个，另一个四个三美元。

sentences.text: Leo politely asks the second seller if the fruit is fresh.
sentences.chineseHint: 利奥礼貌地问第二个卖家水果是否新鲜。

sentences.text: He buys the oranges, bread for two dollars, and tomatoes for three dollars.
sentences.chineseHint: 他买了橙子、两美元的面包和三美元的西红柿。

sentences.text: Leo spends eight dollars and brings two dollars home.
sentences.chineseHint: 利奥花了八美元，带两美元回家。

sentences.text: His mother praises him for checking the price and speaking kindly.
sentences.chineseHint: 妈妈表扬他核对价格并友善交流。

vocabulary.definition: a place where people sell goods
a small stand where goods are sold

questions.prompt: How much money does Leo take?
Which seller has the better orange price?
How much money does Leo bring home?

title: A Message from the Mountain
summary: Three hikers use landmarks to deliver an important note.

sentences.text: Sam, Rina, and their guide find a note tied to a trail sign.
sentences.chineseHint: 山姆、莉娜和向导发现一张绑在路标上的纸条。

sentences.text: It says that a ranger at the north cabin needs a new radio battery.
sentences.chineseHint: 纸条说北边小屋的护林员需要一块新无线电电池。

sentences.text: Their map shows two paths, but the shorter western path crosses a flooded bridge.
sentences.chineseHint: 地图上有两条路，但较短的西路要经过被淹的桥。

sentences.text: The guide chooses the eastern path beside three tall pine trees.
sentences.chineseHint: 向导选择经过三棵高松树旁的东路。

sentences.text: At a gray rock, they turn left and follow the river north.
sentences.chineseHint: 到了灰色岩石处，他们左转，沿河向北。

sentences.text: They reach the cabin before sunset and give the ranger the battery.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们在日落前到达小屋，把电池交给护林员。

sentences.text: The safe route is longer, but careful directions help everyone arrive.
sentences.chineseHint: 安全路线更长，但仔细辨认方向让大家顺利到达。

vocabulary.example: The note is on a trail sign.

vocabulary.definition: a person who protects a park
a way from one place to another

questions.prompt: Why do they avoid the western path?
When do they reach the cabin?

title: The Robot Who Asked Why
summary: A classroom robot learns that good questions need responsible choices.

sentences.text: The class builds a small robot named Dot to sort recycling.
sentences.chineseHint: 班级造了一个叫点点的小机器人来分类回收物。

sentences.text: Dot can identify paper, metal, and plastic, but it asks why each item belongs in a bin.
sentences.chineseHint: 点点能识别纸、金属和塑料，但会问每件物品为什么属于某个箱。

sentences.text: The students explain that sorting keeps useful materials out of the trash.
sentences.chineseHint: 学生解释分类能让有用材料不进入垃圾堆。

sentences.text: One student wants Dot to record every person who makes a mistake.
sentences.chineseHint: 一名学生想让点点记录每个犯错的人。

sentences.text: The class decides that watching people is not needed for sorting and could hurt privacy.
sentences.chineseHint: 大家认为分类不需要监视人，而且可能伤害隐私。

sentences.text: They program Dot to explain the correct bin without saving anyone's name.
sentences.chineseHint: 他们让点点解释正确垃圾箱，但不保存任何人的名字。

sentences.text: Dot keeps asking why, and the questions help the class make better rules.
sentences.chineseHint: 点点继续问为什么，这些问题帮助班级制定更好的规则。

questions.prompt: What information does Dot not save?
